# Windy Talk

> The voice of the Windy ecosystem: talk to your Windy agent out loud and hear it answer, hands-free. Being built: there is no download yet. Windy Talk is coming as a voice mode inside the Windy Word app; the voice engine itself is live and tested every 15 minutes.

- When it ships, it listens while the app is open, notices when you stop speaking, and answers in a natural voice. Talk over it and it stops to listen.
- The thinking runs through Windy Mind on your own Windy account. There is no separate Talk login.
- Voice conversations in English today.
- No audio is ever stored. Conversation text is deleted after 7 days without use, and closing your Windy account erases it.
